newsitem.title: USA: Number Nine Visual faces class action suit.
newsitem.headline: Number Nine Visual faces class action suit.

text.p: A class action lawsuit was filed against Number Nine Visual Technology Corp related to the initial public offering dated May 26, 1995, plaintiff lawyers said.
The complaint charges Number Nine, certain of its officers and directors and its underwriters for the IPO with violations of the federal securities laws.

The lawyers said the company's registration statement and prospectus contained materially false and misleading statements. The plaintiffs are represented by Wolf Popper Ross Wolf & Jones LLP and Shapiro Haber & Urmy LLP law firms.
Based in Lexington, Mass., the company designs and markets high-performance visual technology products for desktop personal computers.
Number Nine was not immediately available to comment on the lawsuit.
